items.summaryZh: 大卫·库特哈德批评马德林赛道首届比赛超车机会寥寥，警告F1组织者若2027年不改变赛道布局便重返该赛道将是“愚蠢之举”。

items.originalTitle: 库特哈德警告：2027年若赛道布局不变重返马德林将是“愚蠢之举”
items.summaryEn: David Coulthard criticised the lack of overtaking at the inaugural Madring race and warned Formula 1 organisers that returning in 2027 without changing the layout would be "stupidity".
detailZh: 大卫·库特哈德警告称，2027年不作改动就重返马德里赛道将是“愚蠢之举”
大卫·库特哈德批评首届比赛缺乏超车机会后，敦促一级方程式在2027年对马德里赛道进行修改
大卫·库特哈德警告一级方程式组织者，在首届比赛沦为巡游之后，如果2027年不在赛道布局上作出修改就重返马德里赛道，那将是“愚蠢之举”
这场比赛受到了批评，因为人们清楚地看到，这条半永久性赛道上几乎没有超车机会。
在兰多·诺里斯从杆位发车后，一次时机不佳的虚拟安全车让他丢掉了领先位置，因为他当时已经驶过了维修区入口。梅赛德斯车手、现任积分榜领跑者安东内利抓住了这个机会，完成了一次成本更低的进站，并最终拿下他本赛季的第八场大奖赛胜利。
在《Up To Speed》播客节目中，前一级方程式车手库特哈德坚称，这项锦标赛必须针对负面反馈采取行动。
"我认为对于车迷，我们必须倾听他们的声音，"他说。"我们不能说，'哦，你们错了。'如果他们说他们觉得这场比赛很无聊，那么嘿，那就是他们的想法。
"我们确实有机会做出改变，因为如果我们不做出改变，回来后又是一场类似的队列式比赛……马克斯·维斯塔潘评论说，当兰多·诺里斯追近他时，他一点也不担心，因为他说，'我只需要像在摩纳哥那样把车开在赛道中间就行了。'
"如果我们收集了所有这些信息，明年回来却一切照旧，把同样的蛋糕配料放进烤箱还指望得到不同的结果，那就是愚蠢。"
这位前红牛车手就赛道布局可以如何改进提出了一些建议。
"一个老式的、较慢的减速弯，就像蒙扎那样的，能创造超车机会，因为那里有刹车距离，"他补充道。"目前的第一和第二个减速弯都太快了。所以你入弯时走的是很浅的线路，速度又太快。
"或者在那附近某个地方，塞进一个环形的发卡弯，鼓励车手们去尝试超车。这是你唯一能做的办法。
“在赛道的中段，那里全是高速和流畅的弯道，你什么都做不了，因为需要让赛道与末端衔接起来，而你必须想办法到达那里。”
detailEn: David Coulthard warns unchanged Madring return in 2027 would be "stupidity"
David Coulthard has urged Formula 1 to alter the Madring circuit for 2027 after criticising the lack of overtaking in its inaugural race
David Coulthard has warned Formula 1 organisers that returning to the Madring circuit in 2027 without altering its layout would be "stupidity" following a processional first race.
The race has faced criticism after it became clear that there were few overtaking opportunities around the semi-permanent circuit.

After Lando Norris started from pole position, an ill-timed virtual safety car cost him the lead as he had already passed the pit entry. Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli capitalised on the moment, took the cheaper pitstop and went on to claim his eighth grand prix win of the season.
Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, former F1 driver Coulthard insisted that the championship must act on the negative feedback.
"I think the fans, we've got to listen to them," he said. "We can't say, 'Oh, you're wrong.' If they're saying they think the race was boring, then hey, that's what they think.

"What we do have is the opportunity to make changes because if we don't make changes and we come back and have a similar processional race... And Max Verstappen commented that he was not at all concerned when he was being caught by Lando Norris because he said, 'All I need to do is drive in the middle of the track as you would in Monaco.'
"If we take all that information and come back next year with exactly the same, then put the same cake mix into the oven and expect a different outcome, that's stupidity."
The former Red Bull driver offered some suggestions as to how the track layout could be improved.

"A good old-fashioned, slower chicane like you have at Monza creates overtaking because you have braking distance," he added. "The first and second chicanes currently are too fast. So you enter on a shallow line with too much speed.
"Or somewhere around that area, you chuck in a loop, a hairpin loop that encourages people to have a go. That's the only thing you can do.
"In the middle part of the circuit where it's all fast and flowing, you can't do anything because you need the circuit to join up with the end, and you need to get there somehow."

items.titleZh: 维特尔：F1须将“我们所热爱的事物”与可持续未来相结合
items.summaryZh: 四届世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔认为，F1拥有将可持续发展目标与精彩的赛道表现相结合的技术。

items.originalTitle: 维特尔：F1须将“我们所热爱的事物”与可持续未来相结合
items.summaryEn: Four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel believes Formula 1 has the technology to pair its sustainability goals with an exciting on-track product.
detailZh: Sebastian Vettel：F1必须将“我们所热爱的事物”与可持续的未来相结合
在蒙扎驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫2002年的法拉利后，Vettel认为一级方程式可以在拥抱可持续燃料和新技术的同时，保留性能与观赏性
Sebastian Vettel驾驶一辆历史悠久的法拉利
四届世界冠军Sebastian Vettel相信，一级方程式拥有将可持续发展目标与激动人心的赛道表现相结合的技术。
作为一名对该系列赛历史有着深厚热情的赛车手，维特尔并不是2014年引入F1的涡轮混合动力系统的最大支持者，他批评其沉闷的声浪以及复杂性对比赛产品的影响。
在2019年俄罗斯大奖赛上法拉利混合动力系统故障后，维特尔在车队无线电中著名地喊道：“把该死的V12拿回来。”
作为一位著名的环保主义者，维特尔的价值观和他对老派赛车的热爱长期以来似乎相互冲突，但尽管“并不认同我们目前规则中的所有内容”，这位德国人也觉得当前的技术进步正在开辟新的机会，在未来将可持续性和刺激性结合起来。
“我觉得这很令人兴奋，”维特尔在意大利大奖赛上说，他在那里驾驶了迈克尔·舒马赫2002年的法拉利F1赛车，该车拥有尖啸、全血的V10发动机。
"当你审视一级方程式赛车时，还有太多东西值得深入探讨。当然，从车手的角度来看，我想驾驶最好的赛车，我想赢得比赛。但什么才是最好的赛车呢？2002年的赛车在当时是最先进的赛车，它代表了一级方程式赛车所象征的许多东西。
"如今的赛车也是如此，我认为这关乎性能、精准、纪律、勤奋，但也关乎责任和对未来的关怀，而这些赛车正在努力做到这一点。
"从驾驶的角度来看，我可能并不完全认同我们目前规则中的所有内容，但展望未来，我认为这正是有巨大机会让人们参与其中的地方。
"两者不必互相排斥。我认为我们需要找到与一切相关的实践方法，这样我们才能将我们所热爱的事物结合起来。"
维特尔长期以来一直倡导使用合成燃料和电子燃料。尽管F1本赛季转向先进可持续燃料的举措来得太晚，未能与他的赛车生涯重叠，但这位四届世界冠军对这项转变为主宰未来规则所开辟的可能性感到兴奋，这些规则预计将在2030年或2031年回归更大、更响亮的V8引擎。
“我认为可持续燃料是向前迈出的一步，”这位39岁的车手说道。“这不仅对一级方程式赛车，也对激励其他赛车系列赛具有巨大潜力。
“如果你塑造下一代汽车，就有很大潜力以负责任的方式做到这一点，因为有些东西从技术角度来看可能令人难以置信，但可能无法转移到街道上。我认为也有责任这样做。
“我期待未来会带来什么，因为我认为F1拥有许多美好的价值观，这些价值观塑造了我，激励了我的生活，并触动了世界各地的许多人。它拥有这种力量，可以在许多其他有意义和有影响的事情上做到这一点。”
维特尔在F1 2022赛季结束后退出了竞技比赛，但仍定期参加冠军赛（比赛 of Champions）表演赛，他已报名参加一月份在新西兰举行的ROC赛事。
detailEn: Sebastian Vettel: F1 must combine “things we love” with sustainable future
After driving Michael Schumacher’s 2002 Ferrari at Monza, Vettel argued Formula 1 can preserve performance and spectacle while embracing sustainable fuels and new technology
Sebastian Vettel drives a historic Ferrari
Four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel believes Formula 1 has the technology to pair its sustainability goals with an exciting on-track product.

As a racer with a deep-rooted passion for the history of the series, Vettel wasn't the biggest proponent of the turbo hybrids coming into the series in 2014, criticising their dulled sound and the impact of their complexity on the racing product.
After a Ferrari hybrid failure in 2019's Russian Grand Prix, Vettel famously shouted, "bring back the f***ing V12s" on the team radio.

As a prominent environmentalist, Vettel's values and his love for old-school racing long seemed conflictive, but while "not agreeing on everything that we currently have in the regulations", the German also feels the current advances in technology are opening up new opportunities to combine sustainability and excitement in the future.
"I think it is exciting," Vettel said at the Italian Grand Prix, where he drove Michael Schumacher's 2002 Ferrari F1 car, boasting a screaming, full-blooded V10.

"There's so much more to unpack when you look at Formula 1. Of course, from a driver's point of view I want to drive the best car and I want to win races. But then what is the best car? The car of 2002 has been the state of art car at that time and represents so much for what Formula 1 stands for.
"The cars today do the same and I think it's about performance, precision, discipline, hard work but also responsibility and caring about the future, which these cars are trying to do.

"I'm probably not agreeing on everything that we currently have in the regulations from a driving point of view, but looking forward I think that's where there's a huge chance to take people on board.
"One doesn't have to exclude the other. I think we need to find practises with everything so we are able to combine things that we love."

Vettel has long been advocating the use of synthetic and e-fuels. While F1's move to advanced sustainable fuels this season came too late to overlap with his own racing career, the four-time world champion was excited about the possibilities the move opens up for the future regulations, which are set to involve a return to bigger and louder V8s by 2030 or 2031.
"I think sustainable fuels are the step forward," the 39-year-old said. "There's huge potential not just for Formula 1 but also to inspire other racing series.

"If you shape the next generation of car, there's a lot of potential to do so responsibly because some things that may be incredible from a technology point of view might not be transferable to the streets. I think there's also a responsibility to do that.

"I look forward to what the future brings, because I think F1 has so many nice values that shaped me and inspired me in my life and touches a lot of people around the world. It has that power to do so on many other things that are meaningful and impactful."
Vettel retired from competition at the end of the F1 2022 season but still competes regularly at the Race of Champions exhibition event, having signed up to take part in ROC New Zealand in January.

detailZh: 京特·施泰纳将马德里赛道争议与拉斯维加斯首秀相提并论，并发出2027年警告
京特·施泰纳敦促马德里大奖赛组织方为2027年修改马德里赛道赛道布局
京特·施泰纳，前哈斯车队领队兼电视评论员
前哈斯F1车队领队京特·施泰纳警告称，马德里马德里赛道赛道的西班牙大奖赛组织方必须紧急修改赛道布局，以应对2027年赛事。
2026年首届马德里西班牙大奖赛因一场几乎没有任何超车的巡游式比赛而遭到车手、车迷和评论员的广泛批评。
尽管基米·安东内利击败马克斯·维斯塔潘和杆位得主兰多·诺里斯，赢得了他本赛季第八个大奖赛胜利，但他是借助时机恰到好处的虚拟安全车取得领先，而非在赛道上超车获胜。
在The Red Flags Podcast节目中，施泰纳承认该赛事周围存在强烈的负面情绪，但呼吁保持耐心，以便做出改变。
“拉斯维加斯第一年时情况完全一样，‘哦，你为什么要去拉斯维加斯？那是做的最愚蠢的事。’它已经变成了一件非常好的事情，有些事情立刻见效，有些事情需要一些微调，”这位前车队负责人解释道。
“如果明年马德里问题没有解决，我会认为这是失败，因为这是一份10年合同。它必须被修复。不能有第二个像这样的年份。
“你记得拉斯维加斯第一年排水盖弹起的事。我们凌晨6点在那里，‘这是一场灾难，他们不知道自己在做什么。’
“所以那里有负面情绪，但现在拉斯维加斯几乎已经成为一场标志性赛事。它似乎已经存在了永远，因为它是如此酷。”
安东内利在马德里的胜利将他车手积分榜上对梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔的领先优势扩大到81分，后者目前排名第二。七届冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第三，落后安东内利101分。
2026赛季第15站阿塞拜疆大奖赛将于9月24日至26日在巴库城市赛道举行。
detailEn: Guenther Steiner compares Madring backlash to Las Vegas debut with 2027 warning
Guenther Steiner has urged Madrid Grand Prix organisers to change the Madring circuit layout for 2027
Guenther Steiner, former Haas Team Principal and TV Presenter
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has warned that the organisers of the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit must urgently change the track's layout for 2027.
The inaugural 2026 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid drew widespread criticism from drivers, fans and pundits following a processional race that featured virtually no overtaking.

While Kimi Antonelli secured his eighth grand prix victory of the season over Max Verstappen and polesitter Lando Norris, he gained the lead after a well-timed virtual safety car rather than overtaking on track for the win.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner acknowledged the intense negativity surrounding the event but urged patience to allow changes to be made.

"It was exactly the same in Vegas, the first year, 'Oh, why would you go to Las Vegas? That's the most stupid thing to do.' It has become a very good thing, and some things work straight away, and some things need some fine-tuning," the former team chief explained.
"If next year Madrid is not sorted out, I would see it as a failure because it's a 10-year contract. It needs to be fixed. There cannot be a second year like this.
"You remember Vegas the first year with the drainage covers coming up. We were there at 6am, 'This is a disaster, they don't know what they're doing.'
"So there was negativity there, but now Vegas has become almost an iconic race already. It seems like it's been there forever because it's so cool."

Antonelli's win in Madrid extended his lead in the drivers' standings to 81 points over his Mercedes team-mate George Russell, who currently sits second. Seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton is third, 101 points behind Antonelli.
The 15th round of the 2026 season, the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, will take place from 24-26 September at the Baku City Circuit.

detailZh: 前工程师呼吁F1引入"增强型"仲裁小组以加快判罚
Rob Smedley提议F1设立增强型仲裁小组以加快比赛中判罚
前法拉利和威廉姆斯车队比赛工程师Rob Smedley提议，F1应引入一个"增强型"仲裁小组，以加快比赛中的判罚决定，避免简单事件在比赛结束后仍悬而未决。
在与主持人Jake Humphrey及前阿尔派车队领队Otmar Szafnauer一同参加High Performance 比赛播客节目时，Smedley解释说，当前FIA仲裁员根本缺乏实时处理每一起冲突的带宽，除非暂停比赛。
"你看到一些'[事件]将在赛后调查'[的消息]，你只会觉得这相当明显，"Smedley解释道。
"现在，他们这样做的原因，如果你了解幕后情况，是因为所有仲裁员都忙于比赛，对吧？你不能暂停比赛说，'让仲裁员来决定。'但可以有一个增强型仲裁小组，能够更快地处理这些。
"当事情发生在赛后时，你仍然应该有可能在赛后进行调查，但只针对真正复杂的事情。它应该直接得到处理。
"你可以完全取消它，就像你不能取消比赛后立即暂定结果一样，正是为了做到Otmar所说的，即纠正可能发生的错误，如果存在违规行为而未被注意到。那么你必须在赛后纠正它。"
他补充说："有很多这样的情况，对吧？底板磨损过度、尾翼高度错误、槽隙太开、太闭，不管是什么，重量不足，所有这些都是。你必须考虑到。
"这是一项技术性运动，因此，你只能在赛后对运动的技术细节进行仲裁，因为你必须测量。"
detailEn: Former engineer urges F1 to introduce "augmented" stewarding group to speed up decisions
Rob Smedley has proposed an augmented Formula 1 stewarding group to speed up in-race decisions

Former Ferrari and Williams race engineer Rob Smedley has proposed that Formula 1 introduce an "augmented" stewarding group to accelerate in-race decisions and prevent straightforward incidents from dragging on beyond the chequered flag.

During an appearance on the High Performance Racing podcast alongside broadcaster Jake Humphrey and former Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer, Smedley explained that the current FIA stewards simply lack the bandwidth to process every clash live without pausing the race.
"You watch some of these '[Incident] will be investigated after the race' [messages], and you just think this is fairly obvious," Smedley explained.

"Now, the reason why they do this, if you go behind the scenes, is because all the stewards are super busy with the race, right? You can't stop the race and say, 'Let the stewards decide.' But there could be an augmented steward group that is able to process these much faster.
"When it's after the race, you should still have the possibility to be investigated after the race, but only for really complex stuff. It should just get processed through.

"You can get rid of it altogether, just as much as you can't get rid of the result being provisional straight after the race to do exactly what Otmar said, which is to right the wrong that could have happened if there's been a breach of regulation and it hasn't been noticed. Then you've got to put that right after the race."

He added: "There's been tons of those, right? Too much plank wear, rear wings at the wrong height, slot gap too open, too closed, whatever it is, underweight, all of those things. You've got to take into account.
"It is a technical sport, and because of that, you can only arbitrate on the technicalities of the sport after the race because you've got to measure."
keyPointsZh: Smedley是在与主持人Jake Humphrey及前阿尔派车队领队Otmar Szafnauer一同参加High Performance 比赛播客节目时提出这一建议的。
Smedley指出，当前FIA仲裁员缺乏实时处理每一起冲突的带宽，因为不能为了等待仲裁而暂停比赛。
他认为赛后调查应仅保留给真正复杂的事件，而简单事件应通过增强型仲裁小组快速处理。
keyPointsEn: Smedley made the proposal during an appearance on the High Performance Racing podcast alongside broadcaster Jake Humphrey and former Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer.
Smedley explained that current FIA stewards simply lack the bandwidth to process every clash live without pausing the race.
He believes post-race investigations should be reserved only for really complex matters, while straightforward incidents should be processed quickly through an augmented stewarding group.

items.originalTitle: 库特哈德呼吁FIA加快安全车决策速度
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard believes the FIA needs to speed up its decision-making process when deploying the safety car in F1 races. He pointed out that after the Spanish Grand Prix, there is clearly still room for improvement in this area.
detailZh: 大卫·库特哈德呼吁FIA加快安全车决策速度
大卫·库特哈德呼吁FIA提高比赛中立化决策的速度
前F1车手大卫·库特哈德认为，FIA在F1比赛中中立化比赛时必须加快决策流程，并表示在西班牙大奖赛后显然仍有“改进空间”。
迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯在马德里环道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛中错失可能的胜利，原因是阿斯顿·马丁车手兰斯·斯特罗尔因刹车故障停在赛道上。当虚拟安全车出动时，领先的诺里斯已经通过了维修区入口线，这让梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利得以低成本进站，并最终赢得他2026赛季的第八场胜利。
“我再次质疑的一点是，从事故发生到出动虚拟安全车、安全车或红旗之间的时间。我认为这可以整理改进，”库特哈德在Up To Speed播客中解释道。
曾担任F1 TV主持人的威尔·巴克斯顿与库特哈德共同主持了这期播客，他随后解释道：“因为兰多出来说，‘虚拟安全车和安全车，以及F1中的一切，都不应该定义一场比赛。这是F1。比赛应该由最佳表现和良好策略赢得。’我理解这一点。
“但安全车、虚拟安全车的问题，无论你是否关闭维修区，虚拟安全车是否出动，完整安全车是否出动，都是运气。你总会落在硬币的这一面或那一面。你要么落在结果极好的一面，要么落在完全毁了你一天的一面。没有真正的中间点。非此即彼。
“所以，无论你怎么做，因为你总会有安全车，你总需要一个为了安全因素而中立化比赛的时刻。它不会每场比赛都发生。它不会一直发生，但如果它发生了，有人会倒霉，有人会走运。这只是运气。
“你如何立法让一个本质上就不公平的时刻变得公平？你无法让它公平。”
当被问及是否认为这个问题有解决方案时，库特哈德补充道：“有改进空间，我们在开头就提到了。从事故到决策之间的时间。
“有些情况绝对明确，比如蒙扎。在Parabolica发生重大事故时，红旗出动花了一点时间，而情况绝对清楚。所以那应该像黄旗出动一样快，红旗就应该出动。所以有改进空间。”
detailEn: David Coulthard urges FIA to speed up safety car decisions
David Coulthard has called on the FIA to improve the speed of its race-neutralisation decisions

Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has argued that the FIA must speed up its decision-making processes when neutralising F1 races, stating there is clear "room for improvement" following the Spanish Grand Prix.

McLaren's Lando Norris lost a likely victory at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit after Aston Martin's Lance Stroll stopped on track with a brake failure. When the virtual safety car was deployed, race leader Norris had already passed the pit entry line, allowing Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli to pit cheaply and go on to claim his eighth victory of the 2026 season.

"One thing I would question again is the time it takes between an incident and either a virtual, a safety or a red flag. I think that can be tidied up," Coulthard explained during the Up To Speed podcast.

Former F1 TV presenter Will Buxton, who co-hosted the podcast episode with Coulthard, later explained: "So because Lando's come out and he said, 'VSCs and safety cars, and everything in Formula 1, shouldn't define a race. It's F1. The race should be won by the best performance and a good strategy.' And I get that.

"But the thing with safety cars, virtual safety cars, whether you close the pits or you don't, when a virtual comes out or doesn't, when a full safety car comes out or doesn't, it's luck of the draw. You're going to be on one side of the coin or the other. You're either going to land on the side that has worked out brilliantly, or you're going to be on the side of the coin that has completely screwed your day. And there's no real midpoint. It's one or the other.

"So, whatever you do, because you're always going to have safety cars and you're always going to need a point at which you neutralise a race for a factor of safety. It doesn't happen every race. It doesn't happen all the time, but if and when it does, someone's going to get screwed, and someone is going to come up smelling of roses. It's just the luck of the draw.
"How do you legislate to make a moment that is by its very nature inherently unfair? You can't make that fair."

When asked if he thought there was a solution to the issue, Coulthard added: "There's room for improvement, and we touched on it right at the top. The time it takes between an incident and a decision.

"Some of them are absolutely clear-cut, like Monza. It took a little while before the red flag when it's absolutely clear we've had a major accident at Parabolica. So that should be as quick as a yellow flag comes out, the red flag should be out. So room for improvement."

虚拟安全车出动时，领先的诺里斯已通过维修区入口线，梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利得以低成本进站，并最终赢得2026赛季第八场胜利。
库特哈德在Up To Speed播客中表示，从事故到出动虚拟安全车、安全车或红旗之间的时间可以改进，并以蒙扎Parabolica重大事故后红旗出动较慢为例。

items.titleZh: 法拉利为何落后，以及接下来的计划
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在2026赛季开局良好，但下半赛季表现下滑，自7月斯帕站后未再登上领奖台。SF-26并非突然失去竞争力，而是对手尤其是迈凯伦的研发速度不断推高标杆，法拉利未能跟上，并推迟了自身升级计划的重要部分。
items.originalTitle: 法拉利为何落后，以及接下来的计划
items.summaryEn: Ferrari started the 2026 season well but has seen a negative trend in the second half, failing to reach the podium since Spa in July. The SF-26 has not suddenly become uncompetitive, but rivals' development rate, especially McLaren's, has progressively raised the benchmark and Ferrari has not kept up, having postponed a major part of its own upgrade plan.
detailZh: 在法拉利凭借巴塞罗那站的胜利迎来一个非常积极的夏季开局之后，其2026年F1赛季的下半程走势却要消极得多。
自7月斯帕站以来，它甚至都没能登上过领奖台。
有时它仍然展现出能够接近领先位置的实力，但随后却未能将这种潜力转化为实际的前三名完赛成绩。
SF-26并非突然变成了一辆缺乏竞争力的赛车，但对手——尤其是迈凯伦——的研发速度逐步推高了标杆，而法拉利近来未能跟上，实际上还推迟了自己升级计划中的很大一部分。
在匈牙利和荷兰之间，也就是夏休期前后，迈凯伦的MCL40获得了一系列空气动力学改进，尤其是底板区域，这让车队向前迈出了明显的一步。
除此之外，还有针对更快赛道的特定解决方案，比如特别的H翼，也就是迈凯伦自己版本的翻转翼——在匈牙利之后除马德里外的所有赛道都使用了——这在降低空气阻力成为优先事项时，拓宽了赛车的配置可能性。
但如果仅用空气动力学升级来解释迈凯伦的进步，那就过于简单化了。
据一些竞争对手称，沃金方面投入最重要工作的一个方面，涉及对轮胎的理解和激活。
这是一个特别重要的话题，因为早在2025年，将轮胎带入正确工作窗口的能力就已经对迈凯伦的表现至关重要，也是诺里斯尤其擅长利用的一个要素。
迈凯伦似乎正是在这一领域又向前迈进了一步。因此，这不仅仅是给MCL40增加了空气动力学负载的问题，而是在利用该负载并让轮胎处于正确窗口方面变得更加高效。
另一方面，在Maranello，早在Zandvoort之前就已经知道，在荷兰引入的升级不会带来特别大的性能提升。
事实上，底板的变化只是最初计划工作的一部分。
带到赞德沃特的这套升级方案，从概念上讲，大约相当于法拉利原本计划在该区域进行的升级的四分之三。一些更为重大的改动被推迟了——因为进展没有达到法拉利的预期。
由Loic Serra领导的技术团队，以及负责空气动力学部门的Diego Tondi，选择不为了赶上荷兰站的窗口而加速整个套件的生产。
法拉利更愿意给空气动力学专家更多时间在其他区域上工作，包括底板，并寻求更大的性能提升。
持续进行工作的区域之一涉及外缘，马拉内罗的技术部门给了空气动力学专家更多时间来开发，他们对当时已取得的收益并不满意，同时也考虑到了预算帽的限制。
预计在下个月晚些时候于美洲赛道，SF-26 上被推迟的改进将首次亮相。这些改进应包括对底板以及自六月巴塞罗那站之后空气动力学专家们持续研究的区域的更实质性升级。
法拉利已接受以一套不完整的方案度过本赛季当前阶段。据 The 比赛 了解，空气动力学部门在下半赛季围绕 SF-26 以非常动态的方式进行了大量工作，在风洞中在新旧部件之间更换不同组件。这是因为一些方案在风洞中并未产生很好的结果。
主要的新部件现在计划在奥斯汀推出，这既是出于后勤原因，也是因为这条赛道的布局非常适合评估所期望的进展。
法拉利的处罚计划正在最终确定
在动力单元方面，法拉利认为它已经通过ADUO 1和ADUO 2的研发达到了既定目标。一直以来都很清楚，ADUO允许的赛季内改动不会为引擎带来颠覆性变化，尽管如此，它仍然遵循了一条符合动力单元技术总监Enrico Gualtieri部门预期的研发曲线。
在蒙扎引入的ADUO 2规格，配备了第四台内燃机和第四台涡轮，据信已经达到了预期。
现在需要解决的问题涉及处罚：勒克莱尔的动力单元在意大利的事故后接受了大量检查，法拉利决定使用ADUO 1动力单元参加马德里站的比赛。
据信该动力单元得以幸存。然而，可以肯定的是，汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔都将在本赛季结束前安装新的动力单元。有传言称，车队可能会最早在下周末的巴库站解锁勒克莱尔的第五台动力单元，从而在那里接受罚退至队尾的处罚，而这条赛道的超车应该是可以实现的。
在车队的理想情况下，第五套动力单元肯定会是适用于勒克莱尔的ADUO 2规格，随后将在剩余的比赛中与在蒙扎引入的那套动力单元轮换使用。
是否在巴库接受罚退的决定，只会在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末期间做出，届时勒克莱尔将在自由练习中使用蒙扎用过的那套动力单元。只有在此之后，并且还要取决于赛车所展现出的性能，法拉利才会决定是否安装新的动力单元并接受罚退。
牺牲在巴库的发车位并不是理想的选择，但这可能让勒克莱尔在接下来的比赛中使用更新的动力单元，同时还能保留在蒙扎引入的那套动力单元可供使用。
汉密尔顿的情况则不同，尽管在他的赛车上引入第五套动力单元的可能性依然存在。这一决定尚未最终敲定。但由于他目前似乎已经退出了车手总冠军的争夺，在剩余比赛中接受一次罚退、从而拥有两套ADUO 2动力单元可供轮换的可能性就变得更大了。
目前，被认为最合乎逻辑的两个地点是墨西哥城或英特拉格斯——或者如果法拉利希望提前进行更改，也可以选择在那三连赛开始时的奥斯汀。
这自然将在很大程度上取决于累积的里程数，以及未来几周内这位七届世界冠军动力单元池中现有动力单元的状况。
detailEn: After a very positive start to the summer for Ferrari with its Barcelona win, the second half of its 2026 Formula 1 season has had a much more negative trend.
It hasn’t even been on the podium since Spa in July.
At times it still shows it can be close to the leading positions, but then fails to turn that potential into an actual top-three finish.

The SF-26 has not suddenly become an uncompetitive car, but the development rate of its rivals – McLaren above all – has progressively moved the benchmark forward and Ferrari hasn't been able to keep up lately, having actually postponed a major part of its own upgrade plan.

Between Hungary and the Netherlands, either side of the summer break, McLaren’s MCL40 received a series of aerodynamic developments, especially around the floor, which allowed the team to make a clear step forward.

Added to these were specific solutions for the faster circuits, such as the particular H-wing, McLaren's own version of the flip-flop wing - used everywhere after Hungary except in Madrid - which broadens the car's configuration possibilities when reducing aerodynamic drag becomes a priority.
But it would be reductive to explain McLaren's progress exclusively through the aerodynamic updates.
According to some competitors, one of the aspects on which the most important work has been carried out at Woking concerns the understanding and activation of the tyres.

It is a particularly significant topic because already in 2025 the ability to bring the tyres into the correct operating window was very important in McLaren’s performance, and an element which Lando Norris in particular has managed to exploit.

McLaren seems to have made a further step forward precisely in this area. It is therefore not only a matter of having added aerodynamic load to the MCL40, but of having become more effective in exploiting that load and using the tyres in the correct window.
At Maranello, on the other hand, it was already known before Zandvoort that the update introduced in the Netherlands would not represent a particularly large performance step.
The changes to the floor were in fact only part of the work initially planned.

The package brought to Zandvoort can be considered, conceptually, around three quarters of the update Ferrari had planned in that area. Some of the more substantial interventions were postponed - because progress was not living up to what Ferrari had hoped.

The choice of the technical group led by Loic Serra, with Diego Tondi at the head of the aerodynamic department, was not to accelerate the production of the entire package simply to meet the Netherlands window.
Ferrari preferred to give the aerodynamicists more time to work on other areas, including the floor, and to look for a greater performance gain.

One of the areas on which work has continued concerns the outer edge, where Maranello's technical department gave the aerodynamicists more time to develop, dissatisfied with the gain that had been achieved up to that point and also taking the budget cap into account.

It is at the Circuit of the Americas late next month that the postponed interventions on the SF-26 are expected to make their debut. These should comprise a more substantial evolution of the floor and of the areas on which the aerodynamicists have continued to work since after Barcelona in June.

Ferrari has accepted going through the current part of the season with an incomplete solution. From what The Race has learned, the aerodynamic department has worked extensively around the SF-26 in a very dynamic way in the second part of the season, changing different components between new and old parts in the windtunnel. This is because some solutions had not produced great results in the windtunnel.
The main new parts are now scheduled for Austin, for both logistical reasons and because of the track layout, which is ideal for evaluating the hoped-for progress.
Ferrari's penalty plan is being finalised

On the power unit front, Ferrari believes it has reached the targets set with the ADUO 1 and ADUO 2 developments. It has always been clear that the in-season changes permitted under ADUO would not produce a game changer for the engine, which has nevertheless followed a development curve that has met the expectations of power unit technical director Enrico Gualtieri’s department.
The ADUO 2 spec introduced at Monza, with the fourth internal combustion engine and fourth turbo fitted, is understood to have lived up to expectations.
The issue to resolve now concerns penalties: Leclerc’s power unit underwent extensive checks following the accident in Italy, with Ferrari deciding to contest Madrid using the ADUO 1 power unit.

The unit is understood to have survived. However, it is certain that both Hamilton and Leclerc will fit a new power unit between now and the end of the season. Rumours suggest the team could choose to unlock Leclerc’s fifth unit as early as Baku next weekend, thereby serving the penalty that would send him to the back of the grid at a circuit where overtaking should be achievable.
The fifth unit will certainly be in ADUO 2 specification for Leclerc and would then be rotated with the unit introduced at Monza over the following remaining races, in the team’s ideal scenario.

The decision on whether to take the penalty in Baku will only be made during the Azerbaijan GP weekend, where Leclerc will run the unit used at Monza in free practice. Only afterwards, also depending on the performance shown by the car, will Ferrari decide whether to fit the new power unit and take the penalty.

Sacrificing the starting position in Baku is not the ideal option, but it could put Leclerc in a position to tackle the following races with a fresher power unit, while at the same time keeping the unit introduced at Monza available for use.

Hamilton's situation is different, although the possibility of introducing a fifth power unit on his car remains open. The decision has not yet been definitively made. But as he now appears to be out of the fight for the drivers' championship, the possibility of taking a penalty in one of the remaining races and having two ADUO 2 units to rotate becomes more likely.
At the moment, two places considered most logical would be Mexico City or Interlagos - or Austin at the start of that triple-header if Ferrari wants to bring the change forward.
Much will naturally depend on the mileage accumulated and on the condition of the power units present in the seven-time world champion's pool over the coming weeks.

大卫·库特哈德赞扬乔治·拉塞尔公开承认梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利目前表现优于自己，而2026年的冠军希望正逐渐渺茫。

安东内利在新马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛上赢得本赛季第八场胜利，将积分榜领先优势扩大至81分，拉塞尔位居第二。与此同时，拉塞尔仅以第五名完赛。
这位英国车手在赛季揭幕的澳大利亚大奖赛上曾是夺冠热门之一。但在墨尔本夺冠以及随后在中国冲刺赛获胜后，他眼睁睁看着自己的冠军希望随着安东内利一场接一场的胜利而溜走。
在Up To Speed播客节目中，13次大奖赛冠军得主库特哈德赞扬拉塞尔在媒体采访中坦诚面对队友目前比自己表现更好的事实。
“我认为我们看到的只是，就像今年的规则更有利于刘易斯[汉密尔顿]相对于查尔斯[勒克莱尔]一样，他们的表现从去年到今年出现了波动，”他说。
“奥斯卡[皮亚斯特里]相对于兰多[诺里斯]状态下滑，而去年直到巴库他还在领跑世界冠军积分榜。所以，这就是这套规则的起伏。”
“基米状态火热，而乔治陷入困境。但公平地说，我认为乔治已经接受了这一点。他直面媒体，回答问题。”
“周末他与马丁·布伦德尔做了一次采访，他说，‘看，基米现在就是比我做得更好。’我认为能公开承认这一点的人很了不起。”
“我们都会这么想，但有时赛车手会把头埋进沙子里，一个接一个地找借口。但我相信乔治。我为他感到难过。这是一个正在溜走的冠军，但他在职业生涯中还足够年轻，会有属于他的时刻。”
detailEn: George Russell praised for honest admission about Kimi Antonelli's F1 form
David Coulthard has praised George Russell for publicly admitting that Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli is currently outperforming him as the 2026 title slips away
Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has praised George Russell for admitting that his Mercedes team-mate and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli is doing a better job.

Antonelli secured his eighth victory of the season at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit, extending his lead in the standings to 81 points over Russell, who sits second. Russell, meanwhile, salvaged a fifth-place finish.

The British driver arrived at the season-opening Australian Grand Prix as one of the favourites for the title. But after winning in Melbourne and the subsequent sprint race in China, he watched his title hopes slip away as Antonelli claimed win after win.

Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, 13-time grand prix winner Coulthard commended Russell for being honest in media sessions about the fact that his team-mate is currently doing a better job than he is.

"I think what we're just seeing is, in the same way that this year's formula has suited Lewis [Hamilton] more relative to Charles [Leclerc], there's been a swing in their performance from last year to this year," he said.
"Oscar [Piastri] has dropped off form relative to Lando [Norris], where he was leading the world championship up until Baku last year. So, it's swings and roundabouts of this formula.
"We've got Kimi coming alive and George is on the ropes. But in fairness to George, I think he's come to terms with it. He's fronting up to the media. He's answering the questions.
"He did an interview with Martin Brundle over the weekend where he said, 'Look, Kimi is just doing a better job than me right now.' I think that's a big man who can admit that publicly.

"We would all be thinking it, but sometimes racing drivers bury their heads in the sand, and it's just one excuse after another. But I believe in George. I feel for him. It's a championship that's slipping away, but he's still young enough in his career that he'll have his moment."
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔在澳大利亚大奖赛赢得开门红，随后又在中国冲刺赛获胜，但之后安东内利连战连捷，使拉塞尔的冠军希望逐渐渺茫。
库特哈德在Up To Speed播客中表示，拉塞尔在媒体面前坦诚面对队友表现更优的事实，并认为拉塞尔还年轻，未来仍会有属于自己的时刻。
库特哈德指出，今年规则下汉密尔顿相对勒克莱尔、皮亚斯特里相对诺里斯的表现都出现波动，安东内利状态火热而拉塞尔陷入困境。
keyPointsEn: Russell started the season by winning in Melbourne and the subsequent sprint race in China, but Antonelli's run of wins has caused his title hopes to slip away.

Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, Coulthard said Russell has fronted up to the media and been honest about his team-mate doing a better job, adding that Russell is still young enough in his career to have his moment.

Coulthard noted that under this year's formula there have been performance swings, such as Hamilton relative to Leclerc and Piastri relative to Norris, with Antonelli coming alive while Russell is on the ropes.

detailZh: 阿尔维德·林德布拉德在离奇的YouTube挑战中险些翻车世界最短的菲亚特Panda
小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德将他的F1赛车换成了一辆破纪录的微型菲亚特Panda
小红牛 F1新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德利用部分休息时间，在最近的一段YouTube视频中测试了世界上最短的菲亚特Panda。
这位19岁车手出现在意大利汽车改装频道Carmagheddon的视频中，驾驶了一辆经过大幅改装的菲亚特Panda。
在视频中，林德布拉德险些将这辆吉尼斯世界纪录保持车辆开翻，但成功救车。该片段还包括这位英国车手在临时赛道上测试机动沙发，赛道包括八字形和小发夹弯。
“老实说，我刚坐上去时相当害怕，”林德布拉德谈到沙发时说。“开它之前我比开F1之前还紧张。在练习甚至排位赛中，我都比开这个更冷静。”
“一旦习惯了，就好多了。这不容易。相当难开，我以前从没想过这辈子会开沙发。”
随后到了驾驶微型菲亚特Panda的时候。挑战是看谁能让Panda做出最高的翘头动作。
“你之前告诉我不可能翻车，所以我超级自信，”林德布拉德说。“我做了第一次，然后我说，‘好吧，我开得太慢了，我得开始加把劲。’”
“最后一次我翘得比预期高了一点。我盯着地板。几乎垂直了，太疯狂了。我想我现在该停了；否则我会把它翻过去，但我玩得很开心。”
这段赛道外的乐趣正值林德布拉德表现强劲的新秀赛季。他目前以31分位列车手积分榜第11位。相比之下，他的队友利亚姆·劳森——最近在红牛顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔——以59分位列第九。
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad nearly flips world's shortest Fiat Panda in bizarre YouTube challenge
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad swapped his Formula 1 car for a record-breaking tiny Fiat Panda
Racing Bulls Formula 1 rookie Arvid Lindblad has used some of his time off to test the world's shortest Fiat Panda in a recent YouTube video.
The 19-year-old driver featured in a video by Italian car modification channel Carmagheddon, getting behind the wheel of a heavily modified Fiat Panda.

During the video, Lindblad almost rolled the Guinness World Record-holding vehicle, but managed to save it. The segment also featured the Briton testing a motorised sofa around a makeshift circuit, which included a figure of eight and a small hairpin.

"I've got to be honest, when I first got on it, I was pretty scared," Lindblad said of the sofa. "I was more nervous before driving that than I am before F1. In practice and even qualifying, I am calmer than I was driving this.
"Once I was used to it, it was better. It's not easy. It's quite difficult to drive, and I never thought I would drive a sofa before in my life."
It was then time to get behind the wheel of the tiny Fiat Panda. The challenge was to see who could make the Panda do the highest endo.
"You told me before it's impossible to roll so I was super confident," Lindblad said. "I did the first one and then I said, 'OK, I'm going so slowly, I need to start pushing.'
"I went a bit higher than expected on the last one. I was looking at the floor. It was almost vertical, it was crazy. I think I'll stop now; otherwise I will flip it, but I enjoyed it a lot."

The off-track fun comes amid a strong rookie season for Lindblad. He currently sits 11th in the drivers' standings with 31 points. By comparison, his team-mate Liam Lawson, who has recently been stepping in for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull, sits ninth with 59 points.

2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格将威廉姆斯2026年的表现称为"令人震惊"，并认为车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯面临重大挑战，需要将这支格罗夫车队带回应有的位置。
威廉姆斯进入2026赛季时已处于不利局面，此前错过了1月在巴塞罗那的私人测试，并在抵达巴林季前测试时赛车超重。
尽管在迈阿密大奖赛引入了重大升级，威廉姆斯在2026赛季中仍难以争夺积分。目前它在车队积分榜上排名第九，积11分——卡洛斯·塞恩斯获得6分，亚历山大·阿尔本获得5分。
在天空体育F1节目中，罗斯伯格指出过于激进的冬季研发计划和严重超重的底盘是车队困境的根本原因。
"威廉姆斯只是搞砸了冬季。他们在研发这款新车时搞砸了冬季。他们在制造底盘时试图非常激进，尝试新方法，真正创新，"这位前梅赛德斯车手解释道。
"结果适得其反，赛车重量超标太多。记住，在这项运动中，10公斤的额外重量相当于每圈慢0.3秒。所以，如果超重，那是巨大的。损失的圈速就是巨大的。
"因此他们正在打一场艰苦的仗，试图从中恢复，因为他们确实拥有最好的引擎。记住，他们用的是梅赛德斯引擎，所以那里没有借口。我确信空气动力学也一定不在最佳状态。所以，他们在这方面还需要取得很大进步。"
他补充道："不幸的是，因为近年来他们处于非常好的位置，确实在进步，我们真的以为他们正在再次永久地迈向前六或前八，而现在他们大幅退步了，这有点令人震惊。
"这对詹姆斯·沃尔斯来说也是一个艰难的时刻，我对他评价很高，但他现在真的必须奋力度过这场挣扎，扭转局面，带领车队回到积极的方向，这并不容易。"
detailEn: James Vowles faces "tough moment" as Nico Rosberg calls Williams woes "a shocker"
Nico Rosberg has criticised Williams's 2026 campaign as a "shocker"

2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has branded Williams's 2026 performance a "shocker" and argued that team principal James Vowles faces a major challenge to bring the Grove outfit back to where it needs to be.
Williams entered the 2026 season already on the back foot, having missed the private testing in Barcelona in January and arrived at pre-season testing in Bahrain with an overweight car.

While it introduced major upgrades at the Miami Grand Prix, Williams has struggled to fight for points in its 2026 campaign. It currently sits ninth in the constructors' standings with 11 points - six earned by Carlos Sainz and five earned by Alex Albon.
Speaking on the Sky Sports F1 Show, Rosberg identified an overly ambitious winter development programme and the severely overweight chassis as the root causes of the team's troubles.

"Williams just messed up the winter. They messed up the winter developing this new car. They tried to be very ambitious in the way they were building the chassis, tried to go new ways, really innovate," the former Mercedes driver explained.

"It ended up backfiring, and they've got a lot too much weight on the car. And remember that 10kg of extra weight in this sport is three tenths of a second per lap. So, it's enormous if you're overweight. It's just enormous lap time lost.

"So they're fighting an uphill battle to try and recover from that because they do have the best engine. Remember, they have a Mercedes engine, so there's no excuse there. I'm sure the aerodynamics must also not be in the best place. So, they still need to make a lot of progress there."

He added: "Unfortunately, because they were in such a great place in recent years, they were really making progress, and we really thought they were moving towards the top six or top eight again permanently, and now they've dropped back massively, which is a bit of a shocker.

"It's a tough moment also for James Vowles, who I rate so highly, but he's really got to fight through this struggle now and turn things around and bring the team back towards a positive direction, which is not easy."

items.summaryZh: 文章探讨了F1车队估值飙升背景下各车队的实际所有权结构，指出如今所有权形式远比过去复杂，并以阿斯顿·马丁、法拉利和红牛为例进行了分析。
items.summaryEn: The article examines the actual ownership structures of each F1 team amid soaring valuations, noting that ownership is far more complex than in the past, and analyzes Aston Martin, Ferrari, and Red Bull as examples.
detailZh: 谁正在从F1车队估值的巨大飙升中获益？在撰写我最近那篇关于为何车队估值攀升如此之快的文章时，我意识到自己并不确切知道每支车队的答案。
出于对估值的兴趣，加上围绕凯迪拉克所有权的持续报道以及最近关于阿斯顿·马丁持股的披露，我想我应该深入探究一番，查看每支车队可获得的持股信息。
“可获得的”在这里是个关键词。根据所有权结构的类型及其注册地的不同，信息的强度和深度也有所差异。
对于“谁真正拥有每支F1车队”这个看似简单的问题，答案实际上非常复杂。在深入挖掘并思考我们是如何走到这一步之后，人们想要拥有一支F1车队部分所有权的原因有三个关键点。这些原因确实有重叠，但自弗兰克·威廉姆斯、科林·查普曼、布鲁斯·迈凯伦和肯·泰瑞尔那个唯一目标就是获胜的“所有者/运营者”模式以来，无疑已经发生了变化。
1）你拥有一支车队，是因为你想去赛车。
2）你拥有一支车队，是因为赛车有助于另一项业务赚钱。
3）你（部分）拥有一支车队，是因为你相信车队本身会为你赚钱。
弗兰克·威廉姆斯在很大程度上代表了第一种。贝纳通和红牛是第二种的例子。Arctos、Otro和其他机构投资者的到来代表了第三种。
但我们距离一个100%由机构投资者拥有的发车格还差得很远，那将代表第三种原因。而这正是细节如此有趣的原因。
如今的车队阵容越来越多地由混合体组成。制造商与私人资本并存，亿万富翁控制者与机构投资者并存，主权财富与企业家并存，甚至高级员工也持有股权。
一旦你深入研究这些结构，车队的一些战略决策和文化差异就变得合理了。吉恩·哈斯是发车格上唯一剩下的100%所有者/运营者。哈斯也是唯一一支运营成本低于预算帽的车队。这或许并非巧合。
由于哈斯是最容易解释的，我将从复杂程度标尺的另一端开始。
阿斯顿·马丁：劳伦斯·斯特罗尔控制它，但许多其他人也拥有它的一部分
斯特罗尔并非简单地“拥有”阿斯顿·马丁F1车队，而阿斯顿·马丁拉贡达——那家名字挂在门上的上市跑车公司——也不拥有这支F1车队。
F1业务最终归属于AMR GP Holdings Limited，这可能是发车格上F1所有权变得多么复杂的最佳例证。
PlanetF1最近对与阿德里安·纽维持股相关的文件进行了详细挖掘，并计算出与斯特罗尔相关的权益约占车队经济所有权的三分之一。
它还强调了更重要的一点：斯特罗尔不需要拥有接近多数的股份就能控制它。
英国公司注册处目前记录显示，斯特罗尔领导的财团控股工具比赛 Point UK Holdings Limited持有AMR GP Holdings超过25%但不超过50%的股份。但它拥有75%或以上的投票权以及任命或罢免董事的权利。
最新的公司章程将比赛 Point UK Holdings定义为“控股股东”，只要它持有公司至少15%的股份。
这一地位带来了重大的治理权利，包括关于任命董事长、董事以及董事会会议所需法定人数的权利。
因此，斯特罗尔实现了现代F1中越来越重要的事情：他为公司引入了大量他人的资本，并兑现了其价值非凡增长的一部分，却没有放弃控制权。
Arctos Partners，全球最大的专业体育投资公司之一，是重要股东。HPS Investment Partners是另一个。沙特阿拉伯的公共投资基金持有权益。纽约喷气机队老板伍迪·约翰逊通过特拉华州实体Green Racer LLC加入。阿德里安·纽维通过特殊类别的股份持有股权权益。还有管理层权益。
PlanetF1的分析将纽维的权益定为约4.7%，比赛 Point UK本身约为27%，与斯特罗尔相关的总权益约为33%。
法拉利：公开拥有，家族影响
法拉利本应也很简单。
它不像阿斯顿·马丁那样是一个单独分拆的F1运营实体。法拉利车队位于法拉利公司内部。
而法拉利是一家上市公司，所以从某种意义上说，它有成千上万的股东。
但这并不意味着在控制权方面所有法拉利股份都是平等的。
截至2026年2月，阿涅利家族的投资公司Exor持有法拉利21.33%的普通股。
得益于法拉利的忠诚投票结构，这些股份代表了32.32%的投票权。
皮耶罗·法拉利的信托基金另外持有10.67%的经济权益，代表16.17%的投票权。
将两者相加，代表约32%经济所有权的权益掌握了约48.5%的投票权。
所以说法拉利是“公开拥有”是正确的。
说法拉利是一家阿涅利/Exor和法拉利家族权益对其保留巨大影响力的公司也是正确的。
这是经济所有权与控制权之间差异的一个很好的例子。
法拉利还有另一个重要区别。如果有人说法拉利F1车队价值50亿美元，并不存在一个包含法拉利车队的独立公司可以简单地以这个数字被收购。
法拉利的F1车队是更广泛法拉利业务的一部分。
这使得将法拉利F1的隐含估值与阿斯顿·马丁或阿尔派的交易进行比较，比大多数估值表所承认的更像是在比较苹果和橘子。
红牛和赛车公牛：两支F1车队，一个战略目的
最简单地说，红牛车队和赛车公牛最终都是红牛帝国的一部分。
detailEn: Who is benefiting from the huge spike in Formula 1 team valuations? While writing my recent piece on why team valuations are ramping up so fast, I realised that I didn’t definitively know that answer for each team.

With the interest in valuations, plus the ongoing story around Cadillac’s ownership and recent revelations around Aston Martin shareholding I thought I’d go down some rabbit holes and look into available shareholding information for each team.
Available is a key word here. Depending on the type of ownership structure and where it is domiciled the strength and depth of the information differs.

The answer to the seemingly simple question of ‘Who actually owns each F1 team’ is actually very complex. Having dug deep and thought about how we got here, there are three key reasons for people to want to own part of an F1 team. Those reasons do overlap but have undeniably shifted since the ‘owner/operator’ models of Frank Williams, Colin Chapman, Bruce McLaren and Ken Tyrrell when the only target was to win.
1) You own one because you want to go racing.
2) You own one because going racing helps another business make money.
3) You (part) own one because you believe the racing team itself will make you money.
Frank Williams largely represented the first. Benetton and Red Bull are examples of the second. The arrival of Arctos, Otro and other institutional investors represents the third.
But we are not anywhere close to a grid with a 100% ownership by institutional investors, representing reason 3. And that’s what makes the detail so interesting.

Today's grid is increasingly populated by hybrids. Manufacturers alongside private capital, billionaire controllers alongside institutional investors, sovereign wealth alongside entrepreneurs, even senior employees owning equity.

Once you dig into these structures some of the strategic decisions of the teams and cultural differences make sense. Gene Haas is the only 100% owner/operator left on the grid. Haas are also the only team operating below the cost cap. This is perhaps not a surprise correlation.
With Haas being the simplest to explain, I’ll start at the opposite end of the complexity scale.
Aston Martin: Lawrence Stroll controls it, but plenty of others own part of it
Stroll doesn't simply 'own' Aston Martin F1, and Aston Martin Lagonda, the listed road car company whose name is above the door, doesn't own the F1 team either.
The F1 business ultimately sits within AMR GP Holdings Limited and this is probably the best example on the grid of how sophisticated F1 ownership has become.

PlanetF1 recently did some detailed digging into filings relating to Adrian Newey's shareholding and calculated that Stroll-related interests account for around a third of the economic ownership of the team.
It also highlighted something considerably more important: Stroll doesn't need to own anything close to a majority to control it.

UK Companies House currently records Racing Point UK Holdings Limited, the Stroll-led consortium holding vehicle, as owning more than 25% but no more than 50% of AMR GP Holdings' shares. But it has 75% or more of the voting rights and the right to appoint or remove directors.
The latest articles of association define Racing Point UK Holdings as the 'Controlling Shareholder' for as long as it owns at least 15% of the company's shares.
That status brings significant governance rights, including around appointment of the chairman, directors and the quorum required for board meetings.

So Stroll has achieved something increasingly important in modern F1, he has brought substantial amounts of other people's capital into the business, and crystallised some of the extraordinary increase in its value, without surrendering control.

Arctos Partners, one of the biggest specialist sports investment firms in the world, is a substantial shareholder. HPS Investment Partners is another. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund has an interest. Woody Johnson, owner of the New York Jets, joined through Delaware vehicle Green Racer LLC. Adrian Newey has an equity interest through a special class of shares. There are also management interests.
PlanetF1's analysis puts Newey's interest at approximately 4.7% and Racing Point UK itself at around 27%, with total Stroll-associated interests around 33%.
Ferrari: Publicly owned, family influenced
Ferrari ought to be straightforward as well.
It isn't a separately syndicated F1 operation like Aston Martin. Scuderia Ferrari sits inside Ferrari itself.
And Ferrari is a publicly listed company, so in one sense it has thousands of owners.
But that doesn't mean all Ferrari shares are created equally when it comes to control.
As of February 2026, Exor, the Agnelli family's investment company, owned 21.33% of Ferrari's ordinary shares.
Thanks to Ferrari's loyalty voting structure, those shares represented 32.32% of the voting power.
Piero Ferrari's trust held another 10.67% economically, representing 16.17% of the votes.
Put those together and interests representing around 32% of the economic ownership command approximately 48.5% of the voting power..
So saying Ferrari is ‘publicly owned’ is correct.
Saying Ferrari is a company over which the Agnelli/Exor and Ferrari family interests retain enormous influence is also correct.
And this is a good example of the difference between economic ownership and control.

There is another important difference with Ferrari. If someone says the Ferrari F1 team is worth $5billion, there isn't a standalone company containing Scuderia Ferrari that can simply be bought for that number.
Ferrari's F1 team is part of the wider Ferrari business.
That makes comparing an implied Ferrari F1 valuation with, say, a transaction in Aston Martin or Alpine slightly more apples and pears than most valuation tables acknowledge.
Red Bull and Racing Bulls: Two F1 teams, one strategic purpose
At its simplest, Red Bull Racing and Racing Bulls are ultimately part of the Red Bull empire.
keyPointsZh: 拥有F1车队的原因可分为三类：为了参赛、为了辅助其他业务盈利、以及相信车队本身能赚钱。
吉恩·哈斯是当前围场中唯一一位100%拥有并运营车队的老板，哈斯也是唯一一支运营成本低于预算帽的车队。
阿斯顿·马丁的F1业务最终归属于AMR GP Holdings Limited，劳伦斯·斯特罗尔通过比赛 Point UK Holdings Limited以超过25%但不超过50%的经济所有权，掌握了75%以上的投票权及董事任免权。
keyPointsEn: There are three key reasons to own an F1 team: wanting to go racing, helping another business make money, and believing the team itself will make money.
Gene Haas is the only 100% owner/operator left on the grid, and Haas is also the only team operating below the cost cap.

Aston Martin's F1 business ultimately sits within AMR GP Holdings Limited, where Lawrence Stroll controls over 75% of voting rights and the right to appoint or remove directors through Racing Point UK Holdings Limited, despite owning more than 25% but no more than 50% of the economic ownership.

items.titleZh: Gary Anderson：F1应做出的四项事故规则修改
items.summaryZh: 前F1技术总监Gary Anderson针对F1处理事故的方式提出四项规则修改建议，包括VSC期间车手必须至少通过起终点线一次、排位赛红旗只从起终点线到事故现场出示、造成红旗的车手应被取消最快圈速，以及比赛红旗期间不允许更换轮胎配方。
items.originalTitle: Gary Anderson：F1应做出的四项事故规则修改
items.summaryEn: Former F1 technical director Gary Anderson has proposed four rule changes for how F1 handles incidents, including requiring drivers to pass the start-finish line at least once during a VSC, throwing the red flag only from the start-finish line to the scene of the incident in qualifying, stripping the fastest lap from a driver who causes a red flag, and not allowing tyre compound changes during a race red flag.
detailZh: F1中有一系列情况长期以来让我感到恼火，上周在新马德里赛道赛道举行的首场比赛中暴露出的问题就是其中之一。
是的，这比每次有车停在赛道上就使用安全车要好，但现实是，如果车手遵守黄旗或双黄旗，并且有一套简单一致的处罚措施，那么我们就不需要如此频繁地使用VSC。
然而，我们已经陷入了这种局面，而且它正在毁掉比赛。
诺里斯绝不应该在马德里赛道赛道输掉那场比赛。他完全掌控着局面，仅仅因为他在赛道上的位置，他就输给了安东内利。就连Antonelli也承认：“获胜很好，但感觉没那么好，因为我认为今天的Lando配得上胜利。”
Norris跑出了一圈排位赛，正如他所说，这可能是他F1生涯中最好的一圈。
他使用中性胎从杆位领跑，并拉开了不错的差距，然后在第14圈结束时，就在他经过维修区入口时，斯特罗尔停车，赛事总监叫出了VSC。他的对手们获得了便宜的进站机会，而VSC在Norris能够利用下一圈之前就被取消了。
一个甚至不需要修改规则的简单改变是：所有车手在VSC期间必须至少通过起终点线一次。
这意味着所有车手都有机会完成一次减少时间损失的进站，从而消除大奖赛比赛结果中的好运气或坏运气。
毕竟，我们在使用安全车时也有类似的做法，安全车在维修区入口处进入维修区，然而，车手们在起终点线之前不能超车。
是的，最终Norris可能因为其他情况而没有赢得比赛，但在他没有过错的情况下可能夺走他的胜利，基本上就是在影响最终结果。
所以我不得不问：这种情况什么时候可能被故意用来操纵比赛结果？这次不是，但如果是在赛季末积分接近的关键时刻，就可能受到质疑。
有些人会说这可能会减少比赛圈数，但我不同意。如果我们看看马德里赛道的这种情况，那意味着我们会在VSC下多待20秒，所以没什么大不了的。
另外还有一件事让我困扰：当排位赛出示红旗时，造成红旗的车手实际上并没有受到任何挫折，除了可能损坏赛车，但正在跑快圈的车手却可能因为不得不放弃单圈而损失一套轮胎。
为什么红旗不能从起终点线出示到事故现场？正在跑排位赛且已经过了事故点的车手可以完成他们的单圈。
此外，如果需要医疗车，它可以从维修区通道末端驶出，这样就在赛道的红旗区域内。
是的，在起终点线和事故现场之间的赛车仍然会损失一套轮胎，但俗话说：你不可能一直取悦所有人，但至少你有可能在某些时候取悦一些车手。
至于造成红旗的车手受到处罚，在F2中，任何造成红旗的车手都会失去所有排位赛圈速。我个人认为这有点过于严厉，但失去那节排位赛的最快圈速会是一个公平的惩罚。如果你在最后一节造成红旗，这可能决定你能否进入下一节排位赛，甚至你的实际发车位。
此外，在比赛红旗情况下，我认为车手不应该能够更换轮胎配方，所以基本上你无法满足比赛使用两种配方轮胎的要求。
是的，你可以更换轮胎以降低因碾过碎片而导致轮胎损坏或爆胎的风险，但这对每个人都是一样的。因此，这再次减少了红旗前已进站和未进站的车手对比赛结果的潜在影响。
detailEn: There’s a set of circumstances in Formula 1 that have irritated me for a long time, something the first race at the new Madring circuit last week exposed.

Yes, it’s better than using the safety car every time a car stops on the track, but the reality is if the yellow flag or double yellow flag were adhered to by the drivers and a simple set of consistent penalties were issued, then we wouldn’t need the VSC quite so often.
However, we have got ourselves into this situation, and it is ruining racing.

There is no way Lando Norris deserved to lose that race at the Madring. He was fully in control, and just because of his on-track position, he lost out to Kimi Antonelli. Even Antonelli admitted, “It’s good to win, but it doesn’t feel as good because I think Lando today deserved the win”.
Norris drove a qualifying lap that, as he says, was probably the best lap of his F1 career.

He led from pole on medium tyres and eeked out a decent gap and then at the end of lap 14, just as he passed the pit entry, the race director called for a VSC when Lance Stroll pulled off. His rivals got a cheap pitstop, while the VSC was recalled before Norris could take advantage on the next lap.
A simple change that doesn’t even require a regulation change would be that all drivers have to pass the start-finish line at least once during a VSC interlude.
This would mean that all drivers would have a chance to complete a reduced time-loss pitstop, so it would take away good or bad luck from a grand prix race result.
After all, we have something similar when the safety car is being used, the safety car pulls into the pits at the pit entry, however, drivers can’t overtake until the start-finish line.
Yes, in the end Norris may not have won the race because of other circumstances, but to potentially steal it away from him through no fault of his is basically influencing the end result.

So the question I have to ask is: when could this situation be intentionally used to manipulate a race result? It wasn’t this time, but it could be questioned if it was a close call for points near the end of a championship.

Some would say it potentially reduces racing laps, but I don’t agree. If we look at this situation at the Madring, it would have meant we would have stayed under the VSC for another 20 seconds, so it's no big deal.

Also another thing that bugs me is that when a red flag is thrown during qualifying, the driver who causes the red flag doesn’t really suffer any setback, other than perhaps a damaged car, but drivers on a quick lap potentially lose a set of tyres by having to abort their lap.
Why can’t the red flag be thrown from the start-finish line to the scene of the incident? Drivers on a qualifying lap that is past the scene of the incident could finish their lap.
Also, if the medical car was required, it could exit the pits at the end of the pitlane so well into the red flag area of the track.

Yes cars between the start-finish line and the scene of the incident would still lose a set of tyres, but it’s the old saying: you can’t please all of the people all of the time, but at least you could potentially please some of the drivers some of the time.

As far as the driver who causes a red flag getting a penalty, in F2 any driver who causes a red flag loses all their qualifying laps. Personally, I think that is a bit heavy-handed, but to lose your fastest lap in that qualifying session would be a fair punishment. It could make the difference between getting into the next qualifying session or even your actual grid position if you caused it in the final session.
Also, during a race red flag situation, I don’t think that drivers should be able to change tyre compounds, so basically you can’t comply with the two-compound race requirement.

Yes, you can change tyres to reduce the risk of tyre damage or punctures from running over debris, but that would be the same for everyone. So it again reduces the potential influence on the race result for those who have pitted prior to the red flag and those who hadn’t.
keyPointsZh: Anderson认为VSC期间所有车手必须至少通过起终点线一次，以消除进站时机带来的运气成分。
他建议排位赛红旗只从起终点线出示到事故现场，让已通过事故点的车手能完成飞驰圈。
他认为比赛红旗期间不应允许更换轮胎配方，以避免影响比赛结果。
keyPointsEn: Anderson believes all drivers must pass the start-finish line at least once during a VSC to remove the luck factor in pit stop timing.
He argues that tyre compound changes should not be allowed during a race red flag to avoid influencing the race result.

items.titleZh: 驾驶风格能解释拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里2026年的困境吗？
items.summaryZh: Mark Hughes撰文分析，拉塞尔认为自己的驾驶风格与2026年赛车和轮胎不匹配，但文章指出维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔的风格各不相同，拉塞尔将两人归为同类并不成立。
items.originalTitle: 驾驶风格真的能解释这些车手在2026年F1的困境吗？
items.summaryEn: Mark Hughes examines whether driving style explains the struggles of George Russell and Oscar Piastri in 2026, noting that Russell's theory grouping himself with Verstappen and Leclerc breaks down because their styles are distinct.
detailZh: 在马德里Q3最后一轮飞驰的前两个计时段，乔治·拉塞尔与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利的差距在0.1秒以内。到整圈结束时，他又多损失了两成。前两个计时段平均每段损失半成，但最后一个计时段损失是这个数字的四倍。
他的后轮对于第三计时段连续反复的90度弯来说实在太热了，而这显然取决于他此前如何使用轮胎。
这定义了他的这个周末——他最终获得第五名，落后夺冠的安东内利半分钟，尽管两人策略不同。
这多少象征了拉塞尔的2026赛季，可能是他八年F1生涯中最弱的一个赛季，而偏偏就在他终于得到一辆具备争冠实力的赛车之时。
赛后他思考了自己今年挣扎的根源，并坚定地将其归为自身自然驾驶风格与2026年一代赛车和轮胎要求之间的不匹配。
“当你看看去年[奥斯卡]皮亚斯特里对兰多[诺里斯]的竞争力、查尔斯[勒克莱尔]对刘易斯[汉密尔顿]，甚至上一个时代马克斯[维斯塔潘]对所有队友的统治力，这是一个奇怪的赛季，”拉塞尔说。
“今年我自己、查尔斯、奥斯卡相比我们的队友都挣扎得多。而马克斯，他的队友们与他的差距比过去六年任何人都要小得多，我认为我们都有非常相似的驾驶风格。
“今年表现非常好的车手——基米、刘易斯、兰多——都有相当相似的驾驶风格。所以对我来说很清楚，用这辆车、这些轮胎，趋势就在那里。”
这些赛车/轮胎与拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里的挣扎之间几乎肯定存在因果关系。他们各自倾向于追求几何上的理想路线：晚入弯，方向盘初始转动相当突兀，更多依赖转向而非重量转移来实现入弯旋转，并且刹车与转向的重叠非常少。
在高抓地力赛道、下压力很大的赛车上，这种风格可以表现得非常出色。但当抓地力下降时就不那么有效了。
在The 比赛会员俱乐部中，通过Mark Hughes和Edd Straw的“驾驶风格秘密”系列获取更深入的F1驾驶风格分析。
2026年赛车下压力和轮胎抓地力的降低，提高了这种技术开始出现问题的赛道抓地力交叉点——也就是说，用这些赛车，比以前有更多赛道与这种技术并不真正契合。
此外，在这些赛车上，能量管理的要求进一步放大了这种代价。入弯时你保持的动量越少，电池补充的就越多，这意味着直道上的部署持续时间不会那么长。拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里都在某些地方为此挣扎过。
但拉塞尔所做的类比在比较维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔时就站不住脚了，他们各自有与彼此、也与拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里无关的风格。
维斯塔潘也许拥有围场内最全面的技能范围，但他偏好一辆前端极其极端的赛车，这让他能用相对较少的转向获得弯中旋转。他对旋转和偏航有着惊人的敏感度，这让他能调整转向/刹车/油门来抑制通常伴随“车头灵敏”赛车而来的潜在出弯转向过度。
任何一辆——比如当前的红牛小红牛22——在低速和中速入弯时转向不足的赛车，都会限制这种技能相对他人能为他买到多少圈速。其他赛车的性能特征表明，在这些规则下完全有可能拥有一辆车头灵敏的赛车。只是红牛一直没能提供这样一辆。
勒克莱尔传统上通过刹车/油门/转向之间充满活力的平衡动作来获得旋转，且重叠很多。这让他在短弯中绝对如鱼得水，因为快速旋转的回报不会被弯中后段的代价所压倒。
他可能是摩纳哥、巴库和红牛环最快的车手。但长弯赛道——上海、匈牙利——会给他带来困难，因为他诱使赛车比最初想要转得更多的做法，会在弯中后段付出代价。2026年规则对能量管理的要求意味着其中一些技巧几乎变得多余。但他仍然是一位快得惊人的车手。
安东内利、诺里斯和汉密尔顿的风格也相当独特——而且适应性强。
事实上，汉密尔顿在地面效应时代挣扎之后，对新一代赛车要求的适应，是本赛季最值得注意的车手表现故事之一。
概括地说，他在入弯时让赛车比勒克莱尔更平、更稳，这意味着在不同弯型中两人各有占优之处。他在需要时仍能超晚刹车，但他将其与一种不会让前轴过度负荷的柔韧性结合起来——而法拉利的下压力平衡让这对他非常奏效。
安东内利和诺里斯显然与各自的工程团队非常努力地理解这些赛车的特性，因为他们在驾驶中引入了专门针对能量管理的特征。例如，安东内利的油门使用极具特色，似乎是为了在刹车下最大化回收而不是在部分油门上浪费。
他的输入非常平滑，因为他以如此精确和自信判断入弯抓地力，以至于弯中几乎不需要修正输入——这可能是他与拉塞尔之间最明显的对比。
这表明他对前轴抓地力有更好的感觉，但当抓地力高时，他也完全乐于采用拉塞尔式的晚入弯/大转向方式。他只是似乎更清楚什么时候那不是最优策略。
诺里斯一直有一种漂亮的方式，渐进地给车头加载，并能根据可用抓地力走任何需要的线路。
和维斯塔潘一样，如果赛车转向不足，这种风格往往会崩溃，但通过这种渐进加载，有时从更远处浅切入弯（在匈牙利站FP1抓地力极低时最后一弯的效果极佳），意味着他在出弯时受到的突然甩尾影响要小得多，因为当前轮最终抓住时他的转向锁角没有那么大。
诺里斯本人并不认为自己的风格是独特的区分因素。
“我不会说我的驾驶风格适合这辆车，”他说。“我认为我的驾驶风格好是因为我能更好地适应。我不认为只有一种风格有效，我开得和基米不一样……我的适应能力让我能驾驭我拥有的赛车。我的长处是我对不同驾驶风格的适应能力。
“去年年初[这辆车]更适合奥斯卡一点。我的长处是能更好地适应，最终理解如何以更好的方式驾驶它。因此我下半赛季表现更好。
“今年？你开这辆车和去年完全不一样，我觉得连1%都谈不上相同。所以关键在于适应。”
归根结底，拉塞尔（和皮亚斯特里）必须适应。因为赛车不会来迁就他们。
detailEn: After two sectors in the final Q3 runs of Madring George Russell was within 0.1 seconds of Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli. By the end of the lap, he’d dropped a further two tenths. An average of half-a-tenth loss in the first two sectors but four times that in the last one.
His rear tyres were simply too hot for the repeated 90-degree turns of sector three and that, obviously, was a function of how he had used them up to that point.
It defined his weekend as one in which he finished fifth, half-a-minute adrift of the race-winning Antonelli, albeit on a different strategy.
It was somehow emblematic of Russell's 2026 season, probably the weakest of his eight-year F1 career at just the time he finally gets a title-calibre car.

Afterwards he was pondering where his struggles this year lay and he puts it firmly in the category of a mismatch between his natural driving style and the demands of the 2026 generation of car and tyre.

"It's been a strange season when you look at the competitiveness of [Oscar] Piastri against Lando [Norris] last year, Charles [Leclerc] versus Lewis [Hamilton] and even the dominance of Max [Verstappen] against all of his team-mates in the previous era," Russell said.

"This year myself, Charles, Oscar are struggling much more compared to our team-mates. And Max, his team-mates have been substantially closer to him than anybody has in the last six years, and I think we've all got pretty similar driving styles.
"The drivers performing very well this year - Kimi, Lewis, Lando - have got quite similar driving styles. So to me it's pretty clear with this car, with these tyres, the trends are there."

There is almost certainly a causal relationship between these cars/tyres and the struggles of Russell and Piastri. They each tend to drive to a geometric ideal, late turn-in with a positively abrupt initial turn of the wheel, relying more on that steering than weight manipulation for rotation into the turn and using very little overlap between braking and cornering.
It can work brilliantly well on a high-grip track in a car with a lot of downforce. But not as well as the grip reduces.

The reduced downforce and tyre grip of the 2026 cars has raised the crossover point of circuit grip at which that technique begins to be problematic - ie with these cars there are more circuits than before which don't really sync very well with that technique.

Furthermore, the penalty of that is compounded in these cars by the demands of energy management. The less momentum you can maintain on entry, the more in-fills the battery makes, meaning the deployment doesn't last as long on the straights. Russell and Piastri have both struggled in places with this.
But the equivalence Russell makes breaks down when comparing Verstappen and Leclerc, who each have their own styles unrelated to each other's or those of Russell and Piastri.

Verstappen has perhaps the most versatile range of skills of anyone on the grid, but his preference is a car with an extreme front end which allows him to derive corner rotation from relatively little steering. He has the amazing sensitivity to rotation and yaw, which allows him to adjust steering/brakes/throttle to dampen out the latent exit oversteer which would normally come with an 'on-the-nose' car.

Any car - such as the current Red Bull RB22 - which understeers at low- and medium-speed entries will limit how much laptime that skill buys him over others. The performance profile of other cars suggests that it's perfectly feasible to have an on-the-nose car under these regulations. It's just that Red Bull has not been able to provide one.

Leclerc has traditionally got his rotation from an energetic balancing act between brakes/throttle/steering, with lots of overlap. It makes him absolutely dynamite around short corners where the reward for the quick rotation isn't overwhelmed by the penalty later in the corner.

He's probably the fastest driver there is around Monaco, Baku and the Red Bull Ring. But long-corner tracks - Shanghai, Hungaroring - can present difficulties for him, as a price is extracted later in the corner for the way he tricked the car into turning more than it wanted initially. The 2026 regulation's demand for energy management mean that some of those tricks have become almost redundant. But he remains a fantastically fast driver.
Antonelli, Norris and Hamilton are also quite distinctive in their styles - and adaptable.
In fact, Hamilton's adaptation to the demands of this generation of car after his struggles with the ground-effect era has been one of the most noteworthy driver performance stories of the season.

As a generalisation, he keeps the car flatter and calmer than Leclerc on entry and this means there is a variance in corner type at which one betters the other. He's still able to be super-late on the brakes when required, but he's combining it with a suppleness that is not overworking the front axle - and the Ferrari's downforce balance is allowing that to work very well for him.

Antonelli and Norris have clearly worked very hard with their engineering teams to understand the quirks of these cars as they've introduced features in their driving specifically tuned to the energy management. Antonelli's throttle usage is highly distinctive, for example, and seems to be tailored around maximising harvest under braking rather than wasting it on part-throttle.

His inputs are beautifully smooth as he judges the grip upon entry with such precision and confidence that there is very little corrective input required through the corner - this is probably the most visible contrast between him and Russell.

It suggests he's just got a better feel for the front-axle grip, but when the grip is high he's perfectly comfortable taking the Russell late entry/big steering approach. He just seems to have a better awareness of when that's not the optimum tactic.
Norris has always had a beautiful way of progressively loading the front of the car up and can take whatever line is needed according to the available grip.

As with Verstappen, it's a style which tends to fall apart if the car is an understeerer, but using that progression, sometimes turning in shallow from further back (seen to great effect in the final turn at the Hungaroring in FP1 when the grip was super-low), means he suffers far less from snaps on the exit, because he doesn't have as much lock on when the fronts finally grip.
Norris himself doesn't see his style as the distinctive differentiator.

"I wouldn't really say my driving style suits this car," he says. "I think my driving style is good because I'm able to adapt better. I don't think it's one style that works and I don't drive the same way as Kimi…my adaptability is what allows me to drive the car I've got. My strength is my adaptability to different driving styles.

"Last year at the beginning [the car] suited Oscar a little bit more. My strength was being able to adapt better to then finally understand how to drive it in a better way. Hence I had a better second half of the season.
"This year? You don't drive this car anywhere close to last year, not even 1% I feel is remotely the same. So it’s about adaptation."
The bottom line is Russell (and Piastri) have to adapt. Because the cars aren't coming to them.
